children: XCF Global provided unaudited pro forma condensed combined financial information reflecting its proposed acquisitions of Southern Energy and DevvStream.
Pro forma balance sheet (June 30, 2026) shows combined assets of $524,785,639 after transaction adjustments.
Post-transaction ownership: XCF Global shareholders 66.67%, Southern Energy 23.33%, DevvStream 10.00%.
Consideration based on $0.45/share (Aug 13, 2026): $64.8M allocated to Southern Energy intangibles; $27.8M to DevvStream.
Six-month pro forma net loss of $43,714,972 and basic/diluted loss per share of $0.08 on 520,433,287 pro forma shares.
Southern Energy accounted as an asset acquisition (no goodwill); DevvStream as a business combination (goodwill of $29.7M prelim.).
